headline: TWITCH'S CHIEF EXECUTIVE PUT A NUMBER ON WHAT A LIVE SPONSOR READ ACTUALLY REACHES.  FIFTEEN PERCENT OF THE CREATOR'S COMMUNITY
deck: Dan Clancy said it out loud yesterday, on the record, while announcing the product he says will fix it.  Nobody on the brand side has been pricing live sponsorship against that number, because until yesterday nobody at the platform had published it.  This is the rare case of a seller handing you the argument for paying him less.
tldr: Twitch's chief executive said on the record that a sponsored segment might reach only 15 percent of a creator's community, and that about 10 percent are watching at any single moment of a stream.  Ask for concurrent viewers during the sponsored segment on your last three live buys, and write clip and Recap inclusion into the next contract as something you own rather than buy later.

Hyundai's Keith Lee campaign did 29 million views and clicks 645 percent above the brand's benchmark, and the agency's stated reason is that it never changed his voice or format — on a creator who had already posted about the car unpaid, because he owned one.  Delete every instruction in your next creator brief that changes how that creator normally opens a video, and start monitoring organic brand mentions as a pipeline.

Kroger, Vidmob and MMA Global forecast e-commerce conversion from 1,900 creative assets with 81 percent accuracy before any media ran, and found the cheapest gain is moving budget behind better creative rather than remaking it.  Rank your last twelve months of video by the outcome you care about, find out how much money went behind the bottom third, and take that number to planning.

Twitch is transcribing streams and using a model to judge which creators match a brand, with nothing published and no appeal route, while the same executive sells the platform's unpolished realness as its advantage.  Ask your representative for the classification taxonomy and the withheld-creator report, and check delivered talent against what you briefed.

Amazon's new Full-Funnel Campaigns lets you approve the creative but not choose the channel or the audience, and reports at format level only, weeks after an FTC complaint about undisclosed auction surcharges.  Name DVA+ advanced mode in your next plan and get in writing which report field contains channel-level placement.

Silent Hill Townfall took 184,388 peak viewers and 7.65 million hours watched from 16,152 channels, matching the 2024 Silent Hill 2 remake's hours off six times as many streamers, and a run of about 100 functioning replica props helped carry its sponsored share to an above-average 3.54 percent.  Divide hours watched by unique channels yourself on every launch number you are quoted, and price a prop run against sponsored broadcasts on your next launch.

Findem and CMO Huddles put median chief marketing officer tenure at 36 months and new arrivals at 2.6 years, while Spencer Stuart's separate tracking says 4.1 years — both shorter than owned video takes to pay back.  Name a second internal sponsor outside marketing for any video commitment that pays back past 2026, with the success measure agreed in writing by both.

**TWITCH'S CHIEF EXECUTIVE PUT A NUMBER ON WHAT A LIVE SPONSOR READ ACTUALLY REACHES.  FIFTEEN PERCENT OF THE CREATOR'S COMMUNITY**
Dan Clancy said it out loud yesterday, on the record, while announcing the product he says will fix it.  Nobody on the brand side has been pricing live sponsorship against that number, because until yesterday nobody at the platform had published it.  This is the rare case of a seller handing you the argument for paying him less.

**1.** Twitch's chief executive said on the record that a sponsored segment might reach only 15 percent of a creator's community, and that about 10 percent are watching at any single moment of a stream.  Ask for concurrent viewers during the sponsored segment on your last three live buys, and write clip and Recap inclusion into the next contract as something you own rather than buy later.

Delete every instruction in your next creator brief that changes how that creator normally opens a video, and start monitoring organic brand mentions as a pipeline.

Rank your last twelve months of video by the outcome you care about, find out how much money went behind the bottom third, and take that number to planning.
**4.** Twitch is transcribing streams and using a model to judge which creators match a brand, with nothing published and no appeal route, while the same executive sells the platform's unpolished realness as its advantage.  Ask your representative for the classification taxonomy and the withheld-creator report, and check delivered talent against what you briefed.
**5.** Amazon's new Full-Funnel Campaigns lets you approve the creative but not choose the channel or the audience, and reports at format level only, weeks after an FTC complaint about undisclosed auction surcharges. **6.** Silent Hill Townfall took 184,388 peak viewers and 7.65 million hours watched from 16,152 channels, matching the 2024 Silent Hill 2 remake's hours off six times as many streamers, and a run of about 100 functioning replica props helped carry its sponsored share to an above-average 3.54 percent.  Divide hours watched by unique channels yourself on every launch number you are quoted, and price a prop run against sponsored broadcasts on your next launch.
